_comment: LLM-authored document spec. The exporter is a thin renderer: it applies THIS file, not hardcoded styling. Copy to docs/<mode>/_document.json, then edit any field to fit the report, audience, and language. Delete a field to fall back to the neutral default. Regenerate a fresh starter anytime with: python scripts/export_report.py --emit-spec --mode <mode>.
title: {{DESCRIPTIVE_READER_FACING_TITLE}}
_fonts_note: Latin and East Asian faces are bound separately, so Latin words inside Chinese/Japanese/Korean text (Gödel, DeepSeek-R1, ·) keep correct glyphs and spacing. 'latin' covers ASCII/accented Latin; 'eastasia' covers CJK in DOCX; 'pdf_latin'/'pdf_cjk' do the same for PDF. Do not set a CJK font as 'latin' or 'pdf_latin'. Symbols outside both (→ ⇒ ✓ ✗ ★ ①) are routed automatically to a wide-coverage system font; no spec field is needed.
